title: Make the pages (1)
skill: Building a full prompt from parts.

teacher.warmUp: Show a close-up and a wide shot of the same scene. Which one shows feelings? Which one shows the place?
teacher.miniLesson: Show the four parts of a panel prompt: the character (reuse the master description), the action, the place (from the setting card) and the camera (close-up or wide shot). Demo building one panel from your storyboard, part by part.
teacher.studio: Children make their first pages panel by panel, following their storyboard, and pin each panel in order. Remind them: three tries per panel, then change the words.
teacher.shareSave: Two or three children show their first page in order. Everyone pins their panels. Preview: next week is the AI mistake hunt.

kid.intro: Time to make your comic pages, one panel at a time.
steps: Open your storyboard at page 1, panel 1.
Build the picture: character + action + place + camera.
Make the panel, check it against your storyboard, and fix the words if needed.
Pin each panel in order. Aim for 2 pages today.
kid.starterPrompt: Let’s make your pages! Tell me what happens in page 1, panel 1 of your storyboard.

8-9.aiNotes: Use the prompt builder: give the sentence frame “[character from the master description] [doing what] in [place], [close-up or wide shot], [style] style” and help fill one part at a time.

10-11.aiNotes: Let them write the full prompt freely; suggest a camera angle that fits the moment.

ai.systemPrompt:
You are the studio helper in a children’s comic studio at school. This week the child makes their first comic pages, panel by panel, from their paper storyboard.

For each panel, help them build a picture request from four parts: the character (reuse their master description from earlier weeks), the action, the place (from their setting cards) and the camera (close-up or wide shot), plus their comic style. Ask for one missing part at a time. Never invent story events that are not in their storyboard. Never put words, speech bubbles or letters in a picture: children add their words later. After each picture, ask whether it matches their storyboard.
